links.title: Class D: (Employment) – Directorate of Immigration Services
Special Pass – Directorate of Immigration Services
Work Permits and Passes – Directorate of Immigration Services
Kenya Foreign Nationals Service Portal

docs.text: Completed and signed Application Form 25
Signed cover letter from the employer addressed to the Director General of Immigration Services
Copy of the national passport bio-data page
Current immigration status (if in Kenya) and recent colour passport-size photo
Valid Tax Compliance Certificate
Certified copies of academic and professional certificates
Curriculum Vitae
Completed and signed Application Form 27
Details of the Kenyan understudy (ID, certificates, CV)
Certificate of registration of the organization and clearance letters
Evidence of competitive recruitment
English translations of foreign-language documents
Special Pass (up to 6 months): Form 32 signed and stamped by the organization, cover letter, passport bio-data page, photo, organization registration certificate, certified certificates, CV

links.title: Student's Pass – Directorate of Immigration Services
Kenya Foreign Nationals Service Portal

docs.text: Form 30 completed, signed and stamped by the institution
Cover letter from the institution to the Director General stating course and duration
Copy of valid passport (bio-data page)
Current immigration status, if already in Kenya
Recent passport-size colour photos
Certified copies of academic certificates (tertiary applicants)
Sponsor's commitment letter and sponsor's passport copy
Proof of funds (self-sponsored students)
Parental consent letter, parent's passport copy and birth certificate (minors)
Institution's registration certificate from the Ministry of Education
Student's curriculum vitae
Police clearance certificate (adults)

links.title: Dependant's Pass – Directorate of Immigration Services
Kenya Foreign Nationals Service Portal

docs.text: Completed and signed Form 28
Cover letter addressed to the Director General
Passport bio-data page and/or national ID of applicant and dependant
Current immigration status of both
Two recent colour passport-size photos of the dependant
Proof of the relationship
Proof of sufficient, assured income to support the dependant
Sworn affidavit confirming the dependant cannot support themselves
Valid work permit with at least six months left (if the applicant holds one)
